question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Languishing
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"languishing"** means to be or become weak or feeble; to lose strength or vigor. (कमजोर होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She has been languishing in her old job for years without any opportunity for growth.
 
 
 
• **"Flourishing" **refers to growing or developing in a healthy or vigorous way, especially as the result of a particularly favorable environment; thriving. (फलना-फूलना)
 
 
• **Example: **The small business is flourishing despite the economic downturn, thanks to its loyal customer base.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'languishing' **is **'flourishing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mesmerising **(मंत्रमुग्ध करना): Capturing one's complete attention as if by magic.

 
 
• **Example:** The mesmerizing performance left the audience spellbound.
 
 
 
• **Temporary **(अस्थायी ): Lasting for only a limited period of time; not permanent.
 
 
• **Example: **They found a temporary solution to the problem while working on a permanent fix.
 
 
 
• **Diminutive** (छोटा): Extremely or unusually small.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his diminutive size, he was a formidable opponent on the wrestling mat.
